video_title: Toronto Raptors Full Media Availability | Practice | October 29, 2026

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Update on RJ Barrett's injury status and recovery timeline
quotes.excerpt: Seven days from now we gonna review where he's at and have a clear plan.
quotes.quote: Seven days from now we gonna review where he's at and have a clear plan. Right now he's going through the treatments. He's reacting well to those treatments, and in seven days time we gonna have a much better feel what it looks like, return to play, what is the timeline. At this point we don't have exact timeline.
quotes.social_post: The Raptors will re-evaluate RJ Barrett in seven days to determine a return to play timeline. He is currently undergoing treatment and responding well.

structured.context: A coach provides an update on RJ Barrett's injury status and the timeline for his return to play.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Praise for Gradey Dick's conditioning and readiness
quotes.excerpt: He really really improved conditioning, he really improved his motor and energy.
quotes.quote: Gradey Dick did a great job. He stayed ready, he's been putting a lot of work in. He had a great summer. He really really improved conditioning, he really improved his motor and energy. Last night was a great example of what it means to be ready. He's going to stay in that mode and when his numbers are called he's going to be ready to perform for us.
quotes.social_post: Gradey Dick is earning praise for his improved conditioning and motor this season. The team is confident he will stay ready whenever his number is called.

structured.context: A coach praises Gradey Dick for his improved conditioning and his readiness to perform when called upon.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Jakob Poeltl's impact on the Raptors' top-ranked defense
quotes.excerpt: We're number one defense in the league at this time and Jakob has a lot to do with that.
quotes.quote: Four games in, Jakob is our starter. We're number one defense in the league at this time and Jakob has a lot to do with that. Jakob does so many things on defensive end of the ball that helps us tremendously. A lot of those things they will not show up in a box score. The way he's presenting himself in the paint, the way he's controlling screeners, the way he rotates and helps our guys.
quotes.social_post: Jakob Poeltl is receiving credit for Toronto's early defensive success. His impact goes beyond the box score, specifically in how he controls the paint and rotates to help teammates.

structured.context: A coach discusses Jakob Poeltl's defensive impact and his contribution to the team's current defensive ranking.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett's growth into a winning player
quotes.excerpt: I really think that RJ is maturing into winning player and to do whatever it takes.
quotes.quote: RJ is one of those guys like when in tough moments, he's not shying away from responsibility. He was just scoring out of transition, he was scoring out of cuts. He was being in the right position, he was playmaking, he was touching the paint and finding open people. I really think that RJ is maturing into winning player and to do whatever it takes to help the team to win.
quotes.social_post: The Raptors see RJ Barrett maturing into a winning player who is not shying away from responsibility in tough moments.

structured.context: A coach reflects on RJ Barrett's growth as a player and his ability to contribute to winning basketball.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on building off the team's defensive success
quotes.excerpt: We've been a good defense past couple years so just trying to build off of that.
quotes.quote: We've been a good defense past couple years so just trying to build off of that and it's collectively, you know, everybody that's coming in in the game is focused, focused on the game plans and I think we're doing well and we can take it to another level.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes says the Raptors are focused on building off their defensive identity and believes the team can take their performance to another level.

structured.context: Scottie Barnes discusses the team's defensive focus and their goal to improve their performance.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on the importance of transition scoring
quotes.excerpt: The object of the game is score more points than the other team.
quotes.quote: Easy buckets, man, free buckets. The object of the game is score more points than the other team. So if we can get some some turnovers and get out in transition and get some easy buckets, you know that opens up the whole game for us.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes on the importance of transition offense: The object of the game is to score more points than the other team, and getting easy buckets opens up the whole game for us.

structured.context: Scottie Barnes explains the importance of transition scoring and forcing turnovers to create easy opportunities.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on the team's huddle response during timeouts
quotes.excerpt: We were just talking in the huddle and like we just saying that we got to pick it up.
quotes.quote: We had a timeout and you know it's kind of we're just we're just talking in the huddle and like we just saying that we got to pick it up. We knew that they were going to come out come out strong like that so we were prepared for it but it wasn't good enough.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes reflects on the team's huddle response during timeouts, noting that while they were prepared for the opponent's intensity, their initial effort was not good enough.

structured.context: Scottie Barnes describes the team's huddle communication during a timeout regarding their defensive intensity.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on his development as a passer and scorer
quotes.excerpt: When you're such a great passer like he is obviously you try to get to that.
quotes.quote: When you're such a great passer like he is obviously you try to get to that. That's how he affects the game a lot for us but at the same time, you know when you're open you got to shoot it and we trust him. He works on his game, he has the ability to score.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes emphasizes the importance of trusting teammates to shoot when open, noting that even great passers have the ability to score.

structured.context: Scottie Barnes discusses the balance between playmaking and scoring for a teammate.
